passages.text: “Cry aloud, do not hold back! Raise your voice like a ram’s horn. Declare to My people their transgression and to the house of Jacob their sins.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His prophet.
God commands the prophet to speak loudly.
God says, "Cry out with your voice."
Do not stay silent.
Lift up your voice like a ram’s horn.
Announce to My people their rebellion.
Tell the house of Jacob about their sins.
passages.original: קְרָ֤א בְגָרוֹן֙ אַל־ תַּחְשֹׂ֔ךְ כַּשּׁוֹפָ֖ר הָרֵ֣ם קוֹלֶ֑ךָ וְהַגֵּ֤ד לְעַמִּי֙ פִּשְׁעָ֔ם וּלְבֵ֥ית יַעֲקֹ֖ב חַטֹּאתָֽם׃

passages.text: For day after day they seek Me and delight to know My ways, like a nation that does what is right and does not forsake the justice of their God. They ask Me for righteous judgments; they delight in the nearness of God.”
passages.sermon:
God speaks about His people.
They seek God every day.
They want to know God's ways.
They act like a nation that does what is right.
They do not turn away from God's justice.
They ask God for righteous decisions.
They want to be close to God.
passages.original: וְאוֹתִ֗י י֥וֹם יוֹם֙ יִדְרֹשׁ֔וּן וְדַ֥עַת דְּרָכַ֖י יֶחְפָּצ֑וּן כְּג֞וֹי אֲשֶׁר־ צְדָקָ֣ה עָשָׂ֗ה וּמִשְׁפַּ֤ט אֱלֹהָיו֙ לֹ֣א עָזָ֔ב יִשְׁאָל֙וּנִי֙ מִשְׁפְּטֵי־ צֶ֔דֶק קִרְבַ֥ת אֱלֹהִ֖ים יֶחְפָּצֽוּן׃

passages.text: “Why have we fasted, and You have not seen? Why have we humbled ourselves, and You have not noticed?” “Behold, on the day of your fast, you do as you please, and you oppress all your workers.
passages.sermon:
The people of Israel speak to God.
They say, “We have fasted.”
They ask, “Why have You not seen?”
They say, “We have humbled ourselves.”
They ask, “Why have You not noticed?”
God answers them.
God says, “On the day of your fast, you do as you please.”
God says, “You oppress all your workers.”
passages.original: לָ֤מָּה צַּ֙מְנוּ֙ וְלֹ֣א רָאִ֔יתָ עִנִּ֥ינוּ נַפְשֵׁ֖נוּ וְלֹ֣א תֵדָ֑ע הֵ֣ן בְּי֤וֹם צֹֽמְכֶם֙ תִּמְצְאוּ־ חֵ֔פֶץ וְכָל־ עַצְּבֵיכֶ֖ם תִּנְגֹּֽשׂוּ׃

passages.text: You fast with contention and strife to strike viciously with your fist. You cannot fast as you do today and have your voice be heard on high.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
You fast, but you argue and fight.
You use your fast to strike others with wicked fists.
You cannot fast like this today.
God will not hear your voice in heaven when you fast with violence and strife.
passages.original: הֵ֣ן לְרִ֤יב וּמַצָּה֙ תָּצ֔וּמוּ וּלְהַכּ֖וֹת בְּאֶגְרֹ֣ף רֶ֑שַׁע לֹא־ תָצ֣וּמוּ כַיּ֔וֹם לְהַשְׁמִ֥יעַ בַּמָּר֖וֹם קוֹלְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Is this the fast I have chosen: a day for a man to deny himself, to bow his head like a reed, and to spread out sackcloth and ashes? Will you call this a fast and a day acceptable to the LORD?
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God asks about true fasting.
God says, “Is this the fast I have chosen?”
God describes a day when a person denies himself.
A person bows his head like a reed.
A person spreads out sackcloth and ashes.
God asks, “Will you call this a fast?”
God asks, “Will you call this a day acceptable to the LORD?”
passages.original: הֲכָזֶ֗ה יִֽהְיֶה֙ צ֣וֹם אֶבְחָרֵ֔הוּ י֛וֹם עַנּ֥וֹת אָדָ֖ם נַפְשׁ֑וֹ הֲלָכֹ֨ף כְּאַגְמֹ֜ן רֹאשׁ֗וֹ וְשַׂ֤ק וָאֵ֙פֶר֙ יַצִּ֔יעַ הֲלָזֶה֙ תִּקְרָא־ צ֔וֹם וְי֥וֹם רָצ֖וֹן לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen: to break the chains of wickedness, to untie the cords of the yoke, to set the oppressed free and tear off every yoke?
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God describes the fast He desires.
God does not want empty rituals.
God wants people to act with justice and mercy.
God says, “This is the fast I have chosen.”
Break the chains of wickedness.
Untie the cords of the yoke.
Set the oppressed free.
Tear off every yoke.
God wants people to help those who suffer.
God wants people to remove every form of oppression.
passages.original: הֲל֣וֹא זֶה֮ צ֣וֹם אֶבְחָרֵהוּ֒ פַּתֵּ֙חַ֙ חַרְצֻבּ֣וֹת רֶ֔שַׁע הַתֵּ֖ר אֲגֻדּ֣וֹת מוֹטָ֑ה וְשַׁלַּ֤ח רְצוּצִים֙ חָפְשִׁ֔ים וְכָל־ מוֹטָ֖ה תְּנַתֵּֽקוּ׃

passages.text: Isn’t it to share your bread with the hungry, to bring the poor and homeless into your home, to clothe the naked when you see him, and not to turn away from your own flesh and blood?
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God explains the fast He desires.
God wants you to share your bread with the hungry.
God wants you to bring the poor and homeless into your home.
God wants you to clothe the naked when you see him.
God wants you not to turn away from your own flesh and blood.
passages.original: הֲל֨וֹא פָרֹ֤ס לָֽרָעֵב֙ לַחְמֶ֔ךָ וַעֲנִיִּ֥ים מְרוּדִ֖ים תָּ֣בִיא בָ֑יִת כִּֽי־ תִרְאֶ֤ה עָרֹם֙ וְכִסִּית֔וֹ וּמִבְּשָׂרְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תִתְעַלָּֽם׃

passages.text: Then your light will break forth like the dawn, and your healing will come quickly. Your righteousness will go before you, and the glory of the LORD will be your rear guard.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
He tells them what will happen if they obey Him.
Your light will shine out like the morning sun.
Your healing will come quickly.
Your righteousness will go ahead of you.
The glory of the LORD will protect you from behind.
passages.original: אָ֣ז יִבָּקַ֤ע כַּשַּׁ֙חַר֙ אוֹרֶ֔ךָ וַאֲרֻכָתְךָ֖ מְהֵרָ֣ה תִצְמָ֑ח וְהָלַ֤ךְ לְפָנֶ֙יךָ֙ צִדְקֶ֔ךָ כְּב֥וֹד יְהוָ֖ה יַאַסְפֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer; you will cry out, and He will say, ‘Here I am.’ If you remove the yoke from your midst, the pointing of the finger and malicious talk, and if you give yourself to the hungry and satisfy the afflicted soul, then your light will go forth in the darkness, and your night will be like noonday.
passages.sermon:
The LORD is the God of Israel.
He listens to His people.
If you call to the LORD, He will answer you.
If you cry out, He will say, “Here I am.”
You must remove oppression from among you.
You must stop accusing others.
You must stop speaking evil.
You must give yourself to the hungry.
You must satisfy the needs of the afflicted.
Then your light will shine in the darkness.
Your night will be as bright as noon.
passages.original: אָ֤ז תִּקְרָא֙ וַיהוָ֣ה יַעֲנֶ֔ה תְּשַׁוַּ֖ע וְיֹאמַ֣ר הִנֵּ֑נִי אִם־ תָּסִ֤יר מִתּֽוֹכְךָ֙ מוֹטָ֔ה שְׁלַ֥ח אֶצְבַּ֖ע וְדַבֶּר־ אָֽוֶן׃ וְתָפֵ֤ק לָֽרָעֵב֙ נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ וְנֶ֥פֶשׁ נַעֲנָ֖ה תַּשְׂבִּ֑יעַ וְזָרַ֤ח בַּחֹ֙שֶׁךְ֙ אוֹרֶ֔ךָ וַאֲפֵלָתְךָ֖ כַּֽצָּהֳרָֽיִם׃

passages.text: The LORD will always guide you; He will satisfy you in a sun-scorched land and strengthen your frame. You will be like a well-watered garden, like a spring whose waters never fail.
passages.sermon:
The LORD will guide you always.
He will satisfy your soul in a dry land.
He will make your body strong.
You will be like a garden that has plenty of water.
You will be like a spring whose water never runs dry.
passages.original: וְנָחֲךָ֣ יְהוָה֮ תָּמִיד֒ וְהִשְׂבִּ֤יעַ בְּצַחְצָחוֹת֙ נַפְשֶׁ֔ךָ וְעַצְמֹתֶ֖יךָ יַחֲלִ֑יץ וְהָיִ֙יתָ֙ כְּגַ֣ן רָוֶ֔ה וּכְמוֹצָ֣א מַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹא־ יְכַזְּב֖וּ מֵימָֽיו׃

passages.text: Your people will rebuild the ancient ruins; you will restore the age-old foundations; you will be called Repairer of the Breach, Restorer of the Streets of Dwelling.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
Your people will rebuild places that have been ruined for a long time.
You will restore old foundations that have lasted for many generations.
People will call you the one who repairs broken walls.
People will call you the one who restores streets for people to live in.
passages.original: וּבָנ֤וּ מִמְּךָ֙ חָרְב֣וֹת עוֹלָ֔ם מוֹסְדֵ֥י דוֹר־ וָד֖וֹר תְּקוֹמֵ֑ם וְקֹרָ֤א לְךָ֙ גֹּדֵ֣ר פֶּ֔רֶץ מְשֹׁבֵ֥ב נְתִיב֖וֹת לָשָֽׁבֶת׃

passages.text: If you turn your foot from breaking the Sabbath, from doing as you please on My holy day, if you call the Sabbath a delight, and the LORD’s holy day honorable, if you honor it by not going your own way or seeking your own pleasure or speaking idle words, then you will delight yourself in the LORD, and I will make you ride on the heights of the land and feed you with the heritage of your father Jacob.” For the mouth of the LORD has spoken.
passages.sermon:
The LORD speaks to His people.
The LORD commands you to keep the Sabbath holy.
Do not walk in your own ways on the Sabbath.
Do not do as you please on God’s holy day.
Call the Sabbath a delight.
Call the LORD’s holy day honorable.
Honor the Sabbath.
Do not follow your own path on this day.
Do not seek your own pleasure on this day.
Do not speak idle words on this day.
If you do these things, you will delight yourself in the LORD.
The LORD will make you ride on the heights of the land.
The LORD will feed you with the heritage of your father Jacob.
The mouth of the LORD has spoken.
passages.original: אִם־ תָּשִׁ֤יב מִשַּׁבָּת֙ רַגְלֶ֔ךָ עֲשׂ֥וֹת חֲפָצֶ֖יךָ בְּי֣וֹם קָדְשִׁ֑י וְקָרָ֨אתָ לַשַּׁבָּ֜ת עֹ֗נֶג לִקְד֤וֹשׁ יְהוָה֙ מְכֻבָּ֔ד וְכִבַּדְתּוֹ֙ מֵעֲשׂ֣וֹת דְּרָכֶ֔יךָ מִמְּצ֥וֹא חֶפְצְךָ֖ וְדַבֵּ֥ר דָּבָֽר׃ אָ֗ז תִּתְעַנַּג֙ עַל־ יְהוָ֔ה וְהִרְכַּבְתִּ֖יךָ עַל־ בָּ֣מֳותֵי אָ֑רֶץ וְהַאֲכַלְתִּ֗יךָ נַחֲלַת֙ יַעֲקֹ֣ב אָבִ֔יךָ כִּ֛י פִּ֥י יְהוָ֖ה דִּבֵּֽר׃ס
